subject: The output of the owning checked values operation.
derivation: A constant equal to the authored rows array length. Every row occurrence counts once, including identical rows; an empty array contributes zero.
inputs: No input-carrier count witness is required. Cell Parameter binding and literal quotation do not change the row occurrence count.
application: The proof must refer to this exact Program operation occurrence, use the rows unit and source derivation (op: source), and have the same value as its authored row count. Equal counts do not make different operation subjects interchangeable.
conditionality: The bound applies if the operation succeeds. It does not discharge schema or cell validation, Parameter binding, resource enforcement, or permission to execute or publish. Failure does not produce a partial successful output.
